description: The organisation's file (/etc/swarmux/managed.toml, %ProgramData%\swarmux\managed.toml). Keys it does not lock are defaults the user may change; keys listed in `locked` cannot be changed.

bg.description: "none" draws no background, so the terminal's shows through.

board.description: The Board: shared state between the agents of a mission.

intervene_confirm_steer.description: Ask a second time before a steer stops a turn.

intervene_max_chars.description: The longest message you can send to an agent, in characters.

intervene_mode.description: How `m` on a running job delivers your message: at the end of its turn, or by stopping the turn first.

metrics_hours.description: How many hours back the verification figures look.

send_back_notes.description: The notes offered when you send work back.

deck.description: The Deck's panels and zones (see `swarmux deck show`).

brief_times.description: Times of day for the owner brief, like "09:00".

extract.description: Find follow-ups in what agents say (calls a model).

order.description: Standing orders: `[[followups.order]]` tables that act on follow-ups by themselves.

protected.description: Globs a standing order may never touch.

font.description: The terminal font to assume for icons, when it matters.

governor.description: When queued work waits, runs cheaper or runs fewer at once.

budget_line.description: Show the budget line on the wall.

downgrade_at.description: Jobs use the cheaper model above this.

enabled.description: Hold, downgrade and limit by the usage windows.

hold_at.description: New jobs wait while a window is this full.

horizon_minutes.description: How far ahead the forecast looks.

load_hold_at.description: New jobs wait while the machine is this busy.

max_job_usd.description: A job that has cost this much is stopped; unset is no limit.

guard.description: Which tool calls are allowed, denied or asked.

allow.description: Allow rules (`Tool(pattern)`). Evaluated after the denies.

always_expiry_days.description: Days an "always allow" rule lasts, 1 to 3650, or "never".

approval_timeout_secs.description: How long a held call waits for your answer.

deny.description: Deny rules: a call that matches is refused, whatever else allows it.

hook_on_failure_block.description: Add onFailure=block to the PreToolUse hook (a Claude Code that knows it).

loop_repeats.description: The same failing call this many times is a loop; 0 turns the loop breaker off.

on_unreachable.description: What a job's hook does when swarmux cannot be reached: auto denies for unattended jobs and passes for the rest.

protected_paths.description: Globs of files agents may not write, besides the built-in ones.

unmatched.description: What happens to a call no rule matches: you are asked, or Claude Code's own rules decide.

jev.description: Removed: JEV no longer exists. The section is ignored with a warning.

layout.description: The dashboard layout: a built-in one or one of your [[layouts]].

layouts.description: Your own dashboard layouts, `[[layouts]]` tables with rows of panels.

locked.description: Keys whose value here wins over every other tier, the command line included. A client-side control, not a security boundary.

low_power.description: Fewer frames and no animation, for a laptop on battery.

max_concurrent.description: Jobs that may run at the same time.

min_free_ram_mb.description: Queued jobs wait while free memory is below this.

drift_threshold.description: A change this far from the plan is drift.

landing.description: auto lands a mission when the gate passes; manual waits for you.

parallel.description: Tasks of a mission run at the same time when they can.

plan_first.description: A mission waits for your approval of its plan.

notify.description: Where swarmux tells you something needs you.

ntfy.description: An ntfy topic URL: urgent items are sent there (leaves your machine).

quiet.description: A 24-hour window with no notifications, like "22:00-08:00".

terminal.description: A terminal notification escape (off on Windows, osc777 elsewhere).

toast.description: Desktop toasts (on by default on Windows).

additionalProperties.description: One model's prices per million tokens.

pricing.description: Model prices that replace the built-in table: `[pricing.<model>]`.

review.description: A second model reviews finished jobs.

when.description: Review only risky changes, or every job.

runtime.description: How jobs launch Claude Code: profiles, canaries, trusted folders.

canary.description: When the deny canary runs before an unattended job.

canary_cache_minutes.description: How long a passed canary is reused (canary = cached).

canary_timeout_secs.description: How long a canary may take.

controlled_sources.description: Claude Code settings files a controlled job loads (user, project, local). Naming project or local lets a repository steer the agent.

hook_failure.description: Whether the PreToolUse hook carries onFailure=block.

mcp.description: `[runtime.mcp.<name>]`: MCP servers (a command or a url) a controlled job may use.

on_error.description: A canary that cannot run refuses the job, or only warns.

profile.description: inherit loads the user's and the repository's Claude Code settings; controlled loads only `controlled_sources` and a generated MCP config; auto makes unattended jobs in untrusted folders controlled.

repos.description: `[runtime.repos."<folder>"] trusted = true`: folders whose own Claude Code settings an unattended job may load.

reviewer_sources.description: Settings files the reviewer loads; the reviewer is always controlled.

statusline.description: Whether swarmux's status line replaces yours.

schema_version.description: The version of this file's format. Additive changes keep it; a breaking change raises it.

telemetry.description: Which background sources run, and how often.

transcripts_path.description: Where Claude Code keeps its transcripts, when it is not the usual place.

theme.description: A built-in theme, one of your [themes], `wal`, `base16:<file>` or `matugen:<file>`.

themes.description: Your own themes: `[themes.<name>]` with `base` and colours by role.

burn_usd_per_min.description: Dollars per minute that is too fast; 0 is off.

compactions.description: Context compactions before a job is called thrashing.

context_high.description: Context use above this is high.

escalate_to.description: The models a job is moved up through before the ladder goes on.

oscillation_repeats.description: A back-and-forth this many times is a loop.

stall_secs.description: Silence before a job is called stalled.

stall_tool_secs.description: Silence during a tool call before it is called stalled.

worktree.description: Where job worktrees go and what they get.

copy.description: Files copied from the main checkout into each worktree.

root.description: Where worktrees are made; empty is ~/.swarmux/worktrees.

stale_hours.description: Hours before an untouched worktree counts as stale.

title: swarmux managed.toml
